$description: Colours of the Forgebox brand icons (docs/design/brand/README.md). Read by apps/desktop/scripts/gen-icons.mjs; edit here, then run `pnpm -C apps/desktop icons`.

pixel.$description: One entry per character of the hand-pixeled grids in pixel/*.txt. null = transparent.

names.v: lid, back-right edge and right band (violet)
names.G: upper plate, top (green side) / green layer
names.L: box, left rim light (blue); theme dependent
names.R: box, right rim light (orange); theme dependent

themes.$description: Overrides of "pixel" per variant. app = icon.ico and the EXEs (any background); light = tray icons for a light taskbar; dark = tray icons for a dark taskbar (lighter rim so the dark box does not vanish).

badges.$description: Tray state badges: bottom-right, half of the icon, 1 px knock-out ring. Each state has its own shape (dot, ring, square, arrow, triangle, "!").

starting.$description: Spinner: a 110 degree arc that turns 45 degrees per frame over a full track.

remote.$description: Remote-context overlay (docs/13 section 5): top-left disc with a centre dot and a 1 px separator ring in the taskbar colour of the variant.

taskbars.$description: Backgrounds of the contact sheet (approximate Windows taskbar colours).
